known_differences_from_fetch_script: Unit is the published offense line (EventOffenseKey = Report_Number + '-' + two-digit Offense_Order), not the SRS hierarchy-rule incident or the NIBRS one-offense-per-code-per-incident unit: the same Offense_Type can repeat within one Report_Number (e.g. VE202126239-01 and -02 are both Aggravated Assault). 2020-2025 pull, UTC year of Incident_Date_Start, before geography: aggravated assault 537/491/429/370/328/287 offense rows vs 479/454/399/327/281/248 distinct Report_Number+Offense_Type; motor vehicle theft 338/268/237/200/249/148 vs 308/253/226/191/237/143.

Rape is not mapped: the pull has no Sex Offenses rows (none of the 23 Offense_Category values in raw_cache_profile.json), although the layer's type list in doc_00.json includes a 'Sex Offenses' category. Rape (11A-11C) cannot be produced from this feed; the publisher does not state why the category is empty.

Human Trafficking, Prostitution Offenses, Pornography/Obscene Material, Liquor Law Violations and Nonviolent Family Offenses are also listed as layer types in doc_00.json but have no rows in the pull.

Only Offense_Type 'Murder & Nonnegligent Manslaughter' appears under Homicide Offenses (20 rows), so 09B/09C are not present to exclude. Simple Assault (4,996 rows) and Intimidation (978 rows) are left unmapped.

Coverage starts in late 2019: 109 rows in 2018 and 2,848 in 2019 against 10,128-15,644 per year for 2020-2025 (UTC year of Incident_Date_Start), so 2018-2019 will reconcile far below the official totals.
Official totals for 2021 are 0 for every offense (official_totals.csv), while the pull holds 15,644 rows for 2021; 2021 cannot reconcile.

Incident_Date_Start is stored in UTC (doc_00.json dateFieldsTimeReference) and the runner takes its UTC year; 76 rows fall on January 1 before 08:00 UTC, i.e. December 31 Pacific time, and are assigned to the following year.
